_note: Which opener (short cutscene / quick-time event) plays when the players open an advent door. Ids are the keys of window.__ADVENT.openers (see Settings > Advent days (1-24)). A list plays in order. An empty list or a missing day = nothing plays. Openers marked auto in the game (intro, witch) play by themselves on a new start, so the door never plays them twice. Marius's dropdown in the settings panel overrides this per device (localStorage kv-advent-assign).
